fields.name: work_and_scratch
fields.meaning: Everything below the save area is the game's working memory (the game runs out of cartridge SRAM); none of it is read back at power-on before being rewritten
fields.evidence: power-on read trace of a verified save with continue: only 0x4150-0x4288, 0x4289, 0x43ea read before written

fields.name: koikoi_signature
fields.meaning: Koi-koi save present marker, the text ALREADYSAVED followed by a zero byte
fields.evidence: code 8000:81e8 writes from ROM c000:4ace; 8000:828b compares; write trace shows 13 bytes stored twice (copy then overlay)

fields.name: koikoi_match_length
fields.meaning: Match length setting: 0 = half match 半どん (6 months), 1 = full 12回戦 (12 months), 2 = endless 無制限 (months wrap, years counted)
fields.evidence: code b000:977d/978a (6 vs 12 vs wrap at 12); settings screenshots show each label with matching work-RAM value

fields.name: koikoi_moon_viewing_rule
fields.meaning: 月見・花見 moon/blossom viewing bonus: 0 = 3文, 1 = 5文, 2 = なし (none)
fields.evidence: code 8000:4b06 copies it from the settings screen, 3-way tests b000:6d2a/6d4f; screenshots show all three labels with matching work-RAM values

fields.name: koikoi_dealer_draw_rule
fields.meaning: 親けん draw to decide the first dealer: 0 = あり, 1 = なし
fields.evidence: code 8000:4b18 copies it from the settings screen, test b000:5725; screenshots show both labels with matching work-RAM values

fields.name: koikoi_player_order
fields.meaning: Per-seat player index, a swapped pair (00 01 in all saves)
fields.evidence: code 8000:6fb7/6fc2 and 8000:6ff2/6ffd write the pair; read b000:6b85/b000:94c2 to map seats to players

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Always 0; referenced by no instruction
fields.evidence: full-ROM instruction scan finds no reference; 0 in all saves and in the live work area across 121 saves

fields.name: koikoi_character_ids
fields.meaning: Character ids: player is always 0, computer opponent is 1-4 picked randomly at match start
fields.evidence: code 8000:60e8 random pick (rng % 4 + 1); read as index times 1200 bytes into a per-character table b000:94d4; portraits differ on the score screen

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Always 0; referenced by no instruction
fields.evidence: full-ROM instruction scan finds no reference; 0 in all saves and in the live work area across 121 saves

fields.name: koikoi_random_seed
fields.meaning: Random number generator state when the month ended; restored on continue so the next month is dealt from it
fields.evidence: code 8000:81fe reads internal RAM 00ea (generator 8000:90e7, multiply 0x343FD add 0x269EC3); b000:2349 restores it via 8000:90ce when continuing

fields.name: koikoi_hands
fields.meaning: Cards in the two players' hands at the end of the last month (8 slots each, card number 00-2f, ff = empty); left over, cleared when the next month is dealt
fields.evidence: code b000:2254 clears 16 bytes to ff at month start; values are card ids

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Always 0; referenced by no instruction
fields.evidence: full-ROM instruction scan finds no reference; 0 in all saves and in the live work area across 121 saves

fields.name: koikoi_round_flag
fields.meaning: Per-month flag (0/1), cleared at month start
fields.evidence: code b000:2319 clear, b000:5735 set, b000:6d72 test

fields.name: koikoi_captured_cards
fields.meaning: Cards each player captured in the last month (two lists of 48, card ids, ff = empty); left over, cleared at month start
fields.evidence: code b000:2241 clears 0x60 bytes to ff; values are card ids

fields.name: koikoi_month_scores_p1
fields.meaning: Points the player won in each month of the current match/year (12 entries)
fields.evidence: code b000:936e writes per month; cleared at match start b000:21c1 and each new year b000:97fb; matches the score-table screen exactly

fields.name: koikoi_month_scores_p2
fields.meaning: Points the computer won in each month (12 entries)
fields.evidence: code b000:9390; matches the score-table screen exactly

fields.name: koikoi_total_p1
fields.meaning: Player's running total score, capped at 9999
fields.evidence: code b000:9384 add, b000:93a4/93b2 cap 0x270f; matches the score-table total

fields.name: koikoi_total_p2
fields.meaning: Computer's running total score, capped at 9999
fields.evidence: code b000:939a add, b000:93be/93cc cap; matches the score-table total

fields.name: koikoi_draw_index
fields.meaning: Draw pile position reached in the last month (0-48)
fields.evidence: code b000:543d/5574 increment, b000:073e compare 0x30

fields.name: koikoi_table_cards
fields.meaning: Cards on the table at the end of the last month (16 slots, ff = empty); left over, cleared at month start
fields.evidence: code b000:2267 clears to ff; b000:24d8 writes

fields.name: koikoi_draw_pile
fields.meaning: Shuffled order of the 48 cards for the last month; left over, cleared at month start
fields.evidence: code b000:222e clears to ff; holds a full permutation of 00-2f

fields.name: koikoi_dealer
fields.meaning: Dealer for the next month: 0 = player, 1 = computer
fields.evidence: code b000:9774 copies the winner byte into it at month end; b000:221b sets it at match start

fields.name: koikoi_last_winner
fields.meaning: Who took the last month: 0 = player, 1 = computer (doubles as the current-turn player mid-month)
fields.evidence: code b000:56df/84ea turn rotation; at save time matches who scored that month across saves

fields.name: koikoi_month
fields.meaning: Number of months finished in the current match/year (the next month to play, 0-based)
fields.evidence: code b000:9761 increment, b000:97bd wrap at 12, b000:97a7 end at 6/12

fields.name: koikoi_year
fields.meaning: Year counter for endless play, starts at 1, +1 each 12 months, capped at 9999
fields.evidence: code b000:21ee set 1, b000:97d5 increment, b000:97df cap

fields.name: koikoi_card_marks
fields.meaning: 48 per-card bytes cleared to 0 at month start; never observed nonzero
fields.evidence: code b000:2279 clear; no instruction writes a nonzero value; 0 in all saves and live work area across 121 saves

fields.name: koikoi_round_pair
fields.meaning: Two bytes cleared at month start; never observed nonzero
fields.evidence: code b000:228b clear; no other reference; 0 in all saves and live work area across 121 saves

fields.name: koikoi_end_flag
fields.meaning: Flag set while the month's scoring runs, cleared at month start
fields.evidence: code b000:9334 set, b000:9324 test, b000:2324 clear; 1 in every verified save

fields.name: hanaawase_signature
fields.meaning: Hana-awase save present marker, ALREADYSAVED and a zero byte
fields.evidence: code 8000:8246 writes, 8000:82e0 checks; no hana-awase save was ever made in play

fields.name: hanaawase_match_length
fields.meaning: Match length setting, same 0/1/2 meaning as koi-koi
fields.evidence: code a000:9bf2/9bff (6 vs 12 vs endless wrap); copied from the settings screen like koi-koi

fields.name: hanaawase_rule1
fields.meaning: Second rule byte
fields.evidence: code 8000:5d0d writes it from the settings screen; compared to 1 at a000:20c1

fields.name: hanaawase_rule2
fields.meaning: Third rule byte
fields.evidence: code 8000:5d1f writes it from the settings screen; compared to 0 at a000:8c88

fields.name: hanaawase_player_order
fields.meaning: Per-seat player index for the 3 players
fields.evidence: code 8000:8054/8061/806e write the triple

fields.name: hanaawase_character_ids
fields.meaning: Character ids: player 0, two computer opponents as two distinct values from 1-4
fields.evidence: code 8000:60e8 hana path picks distinct random values; copied at 8000:6353/6365/6377

fields.name: hanaawase_random_seed
fields.meaning: Random number generator state when the month ended; restored on continue
fields.evidence: code 8000:8266 stores it, a000:2247 restores it via 8000:90ce

fields.name: hanaawase_table_cards
fields.meaning: Cards on the table at the end of the last month (14 slots)
fields.evidence: code a000:2184 clears 14 bytes to ff; 14-slot loop bound at a000:2716

fields.name: hanaawase_draw_pile
fields.meaning: Shuffled order of the 48 cards for the last month
fields.evidence: code a000:215d clears to ff; indexed by the draw position at a000:2733

fields.name: hanaawase_round_flags
fields.meaning: Three per-month flags, cleared at month start
fields.evidence: code a000:2201/220c/2217 clear; second flag set at a000:8ca2 and tested at a000:8cbc

fields.name: hanaawase_hands
fields.meaning: Cards in the three players' hands (7 each)
fields.evidence: code a000:2197 clears 21 bytes to ff; only buffer fitting 3 hands of 7

fields.name: hanaawase_captured_cards
fields.meaning: Cards each player captured (three lists of 48)
fields.evidence: code a000:2160 clears 0x90 bytes to ff; capture writes at a000:23d5

fields.name: hanaawase_reserved
fields.meaning: Cleared at match start; no instruction writes to it, so always 0
fields.evidence: code a000:20fc is the only reference (memset 0, 72 bytes)

fields.name: hanaawase_totals
fields.meaning: Signed running total per player (3 entries), clamped to +-9999
fields.evidence: code a000:8ce0/8cf3 clamp 9999, a000:8d04/8d1a clamp -9999

fields.name: hanaawase_dealer
fields.meaning: Dealer for the next month (0/1/2)
fields.evidence: code a000:9be8 copies the winner into it at month end; a000:214a sets it at match start

fields.name: hanaawase_turn
fields.meaning: Current-turn player mid-month; last winner at save time (0/1/2)
fields.evidence: code a000:78cf/78e9 rotation; read across the turn logic

fields.name: hanaawase_winner_copy
fields.meaning: Copy of the turn/winner byte
fields.evidence: code a000:57d9 writes it from the turn byte; compared to 2 at a000:73cb

fields.name: hanaawase_month
fields.meaning: Number of months finished (wraps at 12 in endless mode; no year counter)
fields.evidence: code a000:9b4d increment, a000:9c15 limit test, a000:9c41 wrap

fields.name: hanaawase_draw_index
fields.meaning: Draw pile position reached in the last month
fields.evidence: code a000:54ce/5618/6662/6794 increment, a000:08b5 compare 0x30

fields.name: hanaawase_round_flag
fields.meaning: Per-month flag, cleared at month start
fields.evidence: code a000:8ea2 set, a000:8e27/8e95 test, a000:2222 clear

fields.name: hanaawase_yaku_flags
fields.meaning: Per-player bitmask of scoring combinations made (3 words)
fields.evidence: code a000:21a9 clears 6 bytes; bit tests across a000:39f5-3f1c

fields.name: hanaawase_pending_flags
fields.meaning: Per-player in-progress flags, merged into the yaku bitmask then cleared
fields.evidence: code a000:78b6 OR into yaku flags, a000:78c3 clear

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Byte between the hana-awase block and the check bytes; always 0
fields.evidence: no instruction references it; 0 in all saves

fields.name: koikoi_checksum
fields.meaning: Check byte for 0x4150-0x4288: sum of (byte XOR its index) over the 313 bytes, low 8 bits
fields.evidence: code 8000:81ab/8226, checked 8000:82d1; write trace shows the store; recomputed on 99 saves

fields.name: hanaawase_checksum
fields.meaning: Check byte for 0x4289-0x43e8, same method over 352 bytes
fields.evidence: code 8000:81ab/8284, checked 8000:8326; same routine as koi-koi, never exercised in play

fields.name: work_and_scratch
fields.meaning: Working memory again (menu state, settings screen, session flags); not read before written at power-on
fields.evidence: power-on read trace

fields.name: internal_eeprom
fields.meaning: Console internal EEPROM: not used by this game
fields.evidence: identical between blank and verified save
